plans.buy_case: AKAM is flashing textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 38.6 in oversold territory, price pinned to lower Bollinger Band with active squeeze, and clean technical structure (50MA > 200MA, price above 200MA). Volume confirmation + neutral VIX make this a low-friction entry for a 4-8 week swing.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on next touch of lower Bollinger Band (~$121-122) OR if RSI dips to 30-32 range on intraday weakness. Do NOT chase at $124.91—wait for pullback.
plans.exit_condition: Take 50% at RSI 60-65 (first resistance), hold 50% until price reaches upper BB (~$135) or RSI flips bearish (>70 + price rejection). Hard stop at $119.50 (below lower BB support).
plans.risk: Competitive cloud security market + earnings volatility (monitor next earnings date). Tech sector rotation risk if growth narrative weakens. $125 position size limits downside to ~$500, which is acceptable for your portfolio.

plans.buy_case: ADM is hitting classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 38.8 (oversold), price at lower Bollinger Band, BB squeeze active, and golden cross already confirmed. Quality defensive name trading at technical support with above-average volume suggests institutional accumulation. Risk/reward favors a 2-3 week swing trade here.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on any dip to $74.50-$75.00 on volume, or immediately at market if you see RSI print 35-37 (deeper oversold confirmation). Do NOT chase above $75.50.
plans.exit_condition: Take 50% off at $77.50 (RSI ~55-60). Trail stop on remainder to $76.00, or exit entirely if RSI breaks above 70 and closes with declining volume (sign of momentum exhaustion). Hard stop: break below $73.50 on volume = exit all.
plans.risk: Defensive/staples sector can grind sideways for weeks; limited upside catalysts if earnings miss or margin concerns surface. ADM also sensitive to commodity prices (corn, soy)—macro headwinds could trap this in range. You also lack recent earnings/valuation context, which is a blind spot.

plans.buy_case: EQR is hitting a textbook mean-reversion setup—RSI 39.8 + Bollinger Band squeeze + price kissing the lower band while staying above 200MA. The golden cross and above-average volume suggest institutional accumulation in a quality REIT at a tactically weakened entry point. This is a clean swing for 4-8 weeks with a clear risk/reward.
plans.entry_condition: Buy on a limit order at $63.50 (touching lower BB). If price rips above $65 without a fill, skip this setup—mean reversion failed. Do NOT chase.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit at 67.50 (RSI >70 or 200-300bps gain). Hard stop at $61.85 (break below 200MA = thesis broken). Exit early if RSI spikes to 75+ (overbought exhaustion).
plans.risk: Sector headwinds in multi-family real estate (rate sensitivity, slowing rent growth) could override technical bounce. If rates spike or recession fears resurface, REITs are liquidated first. Your $192 position limits damage, but volatility could exceed your risk tolerance.

plans.buy_case: AVB is flashing classic mean-reversion signals: RSI 37.6 in oversold territory, price pinned to lower Bollinger Band, and a Bollinger squeeze suggesting imminent volatility expansion. The 50MA/200MA golden cross and price holding above the 200MA provide structural support, ideal for a swing bounce.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on any touch of the lower Bollinger Band (~$175.80) OR if RSI dips to 30-32 zone. Do NOT chase above $178—wait for pullback confirmation.
plans.exit_condition: Take 50% profit at $180 (RSI ~60). Hold remaining 50% for RSI >70 or upper BB touch (~$183.50). Hard stop at $173.50 (breaks 200MA support decisively).
plans.risk: **Major gap:** No current earnings data or recent news context. Real estate headwinds (rates, occupancy) could invalidate the setup. A single negative catalyst could gap below your stop. Only allocate what you can afford to lose—$177 is ~5.7% of portfolio, which is reasonable but not risk-free.
plans.caveat: Before entering, spend 10 minutes checking: (1) latest AVB earnings date + next earnings, (2) recent analyst downgrades, (3) sector headwinds in multifamily housing. If earnings are imminent, skip this trade—vol crush and gaps are brutal for swing traders. If all clear, this is a solid tactical setup.

plans.buy_case: EW is showing textbook mean-reversion setup with a Bollinger Band squeeze and RSI divergence—price made a lower low but RSI held higher, signaling momentum exhaustion. The stock sits comfortably above its 200MA with a golden cross in place, providing a clean technical framework for a swing trade into strength.

If the squeeze breaks downward instead of up, you could see a fast -5% move. Position size ($175) is conservative, which is appropriate given the lack of momentum fuel.
